issue.title: TUI restart still drops an open prompt draft when the pre-restart stash write fails

task_type_fields.impact: When a stash write fails (disk full, lock timeout, permissions), a TUI restart silently loses an open prompt draft. Quitting was fixed for this by epic sase-1ca, so restart is now the only explicit exit path that can still drop a draft.
task_type_fields.repro:
`src/sase/ace/tui/actions/axe.py::_restart_tui` calls `_stash_prompt_bar_before_restart()`. That wrapper (in `_prompt_bar_stash.py`) collapses the `None` ("draft existed but the stash write failed") returned by `_stash_prompt_bar_before_exit(source="restart")` into `False`. `_restart_tui` then sets `_quit_draft_stash_attempted = True` unconditionally and calls `_request_controlled_exit()`. The quit-path guard `_stash_quit_draft_or_cancel` (added by sase-1ca.5) therefore returns `True` without retrying, and the TUI restarts.

Repro: in a sandboxed SASE_HOME, make `prompt_stash.jsonl` unwritable (for example replace it with a directory, or hold the stash lock past the timeout). Open the prompt bar and type a draft, then trigger a TUI restart (the restart action or restart-with-axe from the quit/restart confirm). The stash write fails, only `log.exception` records it, and the restart proceeds, discarding the draft.

The quit paths (sase-1ca.5) cancel the exit and toast in this case. Restart should do the same: treat `None` as "cancel the restart and toast". Run the stash before `exit_action` is set and before the stall watchdog stops, so a cancelled restart leaves the TUI fully live.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the sase-1ca land agent while verifying the sase-1ca.5 quit-path work: quit now cancels on stash failure, but the pre-existing restart path still discards the draft.
